title: Python for Finance
shortDescription: Use Python, pandas and NumPy to analyse markets, build risk models and automate finance work.
description: A practical introduction to Python for finance professionals and students. You will learn the language from scratch, then use NumPy and pandas to analyse returns, build portfolios, compute VaR, run Monte Carlo simulations, price options and backtest simple strategies, with every lesson built around runnable code.
whoFor: Finance students and professionals with no programming background
CFA®/FRM® candidates who want to implement the models they study
Excel users who want to automate repetitive analysis
outcomes: Write clean Python scripts and Jupyter notebooks
Clean, reshape and analyse financial time series with pandas
Implement return, risk, portfolio and VaR calculations
Price options with Black-Scholes, binomial trees and Monte Carlo
Backtest a simple strategy and avoid common backtesting biases

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: You can use a free local Python installation (Anaconda or python.org) or a free online notebook service. Lesson 1 walks through setup.

faq.q: Do I need prior coding experience?
faq.a: No. The first module teaches Python basics from zero.
